title: Carasent initiates SEK 150 million share buy-back program
content:
The board of Carasent AB has authorized a repurchase initiative valued at SEK 150 million to restructure capital and facilitate acquisition financing through equity instruments.

Program Parameters:
- Duration extends through the 2026 Annual General Meeting
- Transactions occur exclusively on Nasdaq Stockholm
- Share ownership cannot exceed 10% of total outstanding shares
- Pricing restricted to the registered market range
- Cash-only settlement for purchases
- Current company holdings: zero shares
- Total shares outstanding: 72,324,781

The board retains flexibility to adjust the program scope based on prevailing market conditions and pricing environments.
